key_reasoning.reason: Single ms_exchange subsystem but 4+ components: client_base contract, Graph and EWS clients, tools/toolkit/tools_vars, errors, plus two new abstractions (write_retry single retry owner with Deadline/Retry/Stop classifier, write_validation shared input checks). One workflow_models enum entry outside the package. Held at L because it stays inside one subsystem.

Mutating, non-idempotent operations (send, forward, move, delete, tag) over two transports with outcome-aware errors (Not applied vs Unknown), proven-no-change retry classification, rate-limit handling and additive category tagging. No exact precedent: the read-side retry.py policy is deliberately separate. Input validation never echoes values (security-sensitive). Many enumerated edge and error cases, covered by purpose-built suites (write_errors, write_library_facts, write_validation).

21 files per diffstat (16+ maps to XXL): 11 source/doc files (2 new: write_retry, write_validation) and 10 test files (most new). 6663 insertions, mostly tests. Scored by the diffstat mapping; the source-only count (about 11) would be XL.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk raised: mutating operations with irreversible side effects (sent mail, deletion) and security-sensitive input validation
Edge/error-case enumeration in acceptance criteria with no pre-existing write-side test template: Technical Risk bumped
